suggestions.issue: The related term "Body" is too vague to help a learner build a knowledge map; standing alone it does not clearly connect to the yoke-mount concept and could confuse a beginner about what is being referenced.
suggestions.suggestion: Replace "Body" with a clearer, on-topic anchor such as "Microphone Stand" or "Mic Clip", or qualify it as "Microphone Body" so the relationship is explicit.

suggestions.issue: The related_terms (Coverage map, Optimization, System baseline, Speech intelligibility, Walk test) are all measurement/tuning concepts and do not build a sensible knowledge map for the multi-zone architecture idea; a learner clicking these lands on tuning topics rather than the adjacent zoning concepts. The sibling entry "Zoning" links far more coherently (Multi-Zone Audio, Source Selection, Paging System, Home Run).
suggestions.suggestion: Swap in architecture-adjacent anchors such as "Zoning", "Source Selection", "Paging System", and "Remote Volume Control" so the map reflects how zones are actually built and controlled.
